tasks.short: Price carbon trading products and write the risks the curve ignores.

steps.what: Read the contract terms of the carbon trading products.

loop.input: Carbon trading contracts and the exchange notice
loop.output: Rows for product, delivery, price index and volume
loop.check: The analyst checks delivery against the contract clause
loop.stop: One pass; a clause that is not standard stays blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Contracts mix a term sheet with narrative, so a fixed map misses delivery

steps.what: Price the carbon trading products on the house curve.
Tie the carbon price to the exchange settlement.
Judge basis and delivery risks the curve ignores.
Write the pricing and risks note for the carbon products.

tasks.design: Contract terms are read, and the house curve prices the carbon trading products. The price is tied to the exchange settlement. Basis and delivery risks the curve ignores stay a judgement, and the note is released only after the analyst writes it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Prices were copied off the curve without the delivery clause, so a settlement difference had no explanation.
tasks.enabler_now: A curve price and a settlement tie are rules once terms exist. Judging delivery risk the curve does not contain cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A contract whose delivery is not on the house curve.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst knows when a tied price still hides a delivery risk.
tasks.altitude: The curve price is ready before the judgement. The analyst still judges delivery risk and can hold the note. Decision rights on the risk do not move.

reach.task: Say which delivery clauses an inspection treats as part of the product
reach.learn: Which carbon contract terms are not just a price

evidence.claim: In a published spreadsheet-agent test, most models ended a cash waterfall at €1.16 million, not €580,000.
Delivery risk on a carbon contract is not a score of a natural person, and it stays with the analyst who read the clause.

assumptions: Focal role is the quantitative analyst. Boundary: from a carbon contract to a released risk note. Trading the product is outside this task.

Structured fields are product, delivery, price index, curve price and settlement. The contract produces delivery; the curve produces the price. Fallback: a nonstandard delivery clause stays blank and is not priced as standard.
Configure the curve price on {DATA_PLATFORM} before custom code.
Upkeep of 5 hours per 100 baseline hours covers a new delivery type on the term extract.
This note does not score a natural person.
unknowns: Whether carbon contracts are stored with a delivery field.
Whether the exchange settlement is available on the same identifier.
research_questions: What share of contracts have a standard delivery clause?
How often does a tied price still get a delivery-risk note?

incremental.description: Add a delivery type to the term extract

approvals.approved_version: risk note the analyst wrote against the tied carbon price and the delivery judgement

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: delivery clauses are nonstandard, so the curve is not used and the note is written by hand. High: terms are standard and only the price and the tie shrink. The delivery judgement stays.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is still reading delivery clauses and writing the risk the curve does not show. Terms, curve prices and settlement ties are ready beforehand. The analyst can hold a risk note.
reach: Environmental compliance inspectors: say which delivery clauses are part of the carbon product
skills_to_grow: Reading a delivery clause the house curve does not price
Holding a note when the settlement tie still hides a basis risk
role.ambitious_version: Every released carbon note ties to a settlement and states the delivery risk the curve ignored.
